hive-lord.title: Hive Lord
hive-lord.description: Hive Lords are enormous subterranean Terminids and one of the largest known organisms fielded by the Terminid swarm. The strain existed during the First Galactic War but was believed to have gone extinct. Prolonged mutation within the Gloom caused Hive Lords to reappear during the Second Galactic War. They were encountered beneath the Hive World Oshaune, where their massive burrowing bodies could move through the planet's underground networks and erupt onto the battlefield. Large numbers of Hive Lords later participated in the Terminid defense of Oshaune against the Helldiver offensive.

impaler.title: Impaler
impaler.description: The Impaler is a massive Terminid strain recognizable by the enormous armored carapace surrounding its head. When attacking, an Impaler anchors itself to the ground and deploys long subterranean tentacles that erupt beneath distant targets, allowing it to threaten Helldivers without directly approaching them. Impalers were encountered during the First Galactic War and were believed to have been driven to extinction. They later reappeared during the Second Galactic War, demonstrating the Terminids' ability to restore previously lost strains.

alpha-commander.title: Alpha Commander
alpha-commander.description: The Alpha Commander is a heavier and more durable variant of the Brood Commander. Hyperevolved as a result of the Gloom, it possesses powerful claws and an aggressive charging attack. Unlike ordinary Brood Commanders, Alpha Commanders summon groups of Alpha Warriors, faster and deadlier variants of standard Terminid Warriors. They are encountered on the highest combat difficulties and can continue summoning reinforcements even after suffering severe injuries.

charger.title: Charger
charger.description: The Charger is a large and heavily armored Terminid specialized in high-speed frontal attacks. Its thick exoskeleton protects most of its body while allowing it to charge directly through Helldiver formations, trampling soldiers and smashing through obstacles. Chargers are among the Terminids' most recognizable heavy assault organisms and have produced several specialized variants during the Second Galactic War.

bile-titan.title: Bile Titan
bile-titan.description: The Bile Titan is one of the largest and most dangerous Terminid organisms regularly encountered by Helldivers. Protected by heavy armor and supported by enormous legs capable of crushing infantry, the creature can also project streams of highly corrosive bile across the battlefield. A single Bile Titan is considered capable of destroying an entire SEAF platoon and generally requires dedicated anti-tank weaponry or heavy Stratagem support to eliminate.

bile-titan.title: Bile Titan
bile-titan.description: The Bile Titan is one of the largest and most dangerous Terminid organisms regularly encountered by Helldivers. Protected by heavy armor and supported by enormous legs capable of crushing infantry, the creature can also project streams of highly corrosive bile across the battlefield. A single Bile Titan is considered capable of destroying an entire SEAF platoon and generally requires dedicated anti-tank weaponry or heavy Stratagem support to eliminate.

charger-behemoth.title: Charger Behemoth
charger-behemoth.description: The Charger Behemoth is a more heavily armored and durable variant of the standard Charger. Originally encountered in limited circumstances, Behemoths later became a regular battlefield threat during the Second Galactic War. They retain the devastating charging behavior of ordinary Chargers but possess greater resilience, making them a particularly dangerous heavy Terminid on high-intensity battlefields.

spore-charger.title: Spore Charger
spore-charger.description: The Spore Charger is a mutated Charger variant surrounded by a dense cloud of Terminid spores. The moving cloud dramatically reduces visibility and can conceal the creature until it charges out of the fog toward its target. When killed, the Spore Charger violently explodes and releases corrosive material, making even its death dangerous to nearby Helldivers.

shrieker.title: Shrieker
shrieker.description: Shriekers are flying Terminids specialized in rapid hit-and-run attacks. They first began appearing during the deployment of the Terminid Control System, with their numbers increasing following the activation of Termicide across the Barrier Planets. Shriekers emerge from specialized Shrieker Nests and attack by circling above Helldivers before diving at high speed with their razor-sharp limbs. Their sudden evolution became one of the early warning signs that Termicide was causing unexpected changes within the Terminid population.

brood-commander.title: Brood Commander
brood-commander.description: The Brood Commander is a leadership-class Terminid responsible for coordinating attacks and reinforcing the swarm. Larger and more dangerous than ordinary Warriors, Brood Commanders can summon groups of Warriors and release pheromones capable of triggering Bug Breaches. Even after suffering fatal damage to the head, they can enter a berserk state and continue attacking until they bleed out.

dragonroach.title: Dragonroach
dragonroach.description: The Dragonroach is a massive flying Terminid created through Gloom-induced mutation. First encountered during Helldiver operations around the Hive World Oshaune, it represents one of the most dangerous airborne Terminid organisms yet discovered. Protected by heavy armor, the Dragonroach circles high above the battlefield before diving toward its prey and unleashing sweeping attacks of combustible venom that ignite the ground. Its emergence demonstrated that the Gloom was capable of producing entirely new forms of massive Terminid life.

rupture-strain.title: Rupture Strain
rupture-strain.description: The Rupture Strain is a specialized Terminid subfaction created through mutation within the Gloom. First encountered during Helldiver expeditions into the Hive Worlds, the strain consists of Rupture Warriors, Rupture Spewers, and Rupture Chargers. These Terminids have adapted to subterranean environments and share the ability to burrow underground, rapidly approach their targets, and erupt from beneath the surface to ambush Helldivers. The strain represents one of several dangerous new evolutionary branches produced by the Gloom.

predator-strain.title: Predator Strain
predator-strain.description: The Predator Strain is a Gloom-enhanced Terminid subfaction consisting of Predator Hunters and Predator Stalkers. First encountered during an attack on the Center of Science on Fenrir III in February 2185, these mutated Terminids displayed unusual discoloration, increased intelligence, and drastically altered hunting behavior. Predator units specialize in speed, flanking, ambush tactics, and concealment. Predator Hunters possess cloaking abilities, while Predator Stalkers sacrifice the traditional Stalker's cloak in favor of appearing in much greater numbers.

spore-burst-strain.title: Spore Burst Strain
spore-burst-strain.description: The Spore Burst Strain is a Gloom-mutated Terminid subfaction first encountered during the First Gloom Expedition. The strain includes mutated Scavengers, Hunters, Warriors, and Bile Titans. Spore Burst Terminids are unusually fast and release explosive clouds of spores when killed. These clouds can damage Helldivers, obscure vision, and drive nearby Spore Burst Terminids into a frenzy that dramatically increases their speed. The strain was originally encountered within the Gloom, demonstrating the extreme evolutionary effects of prolonged exposure to the phenomenon.

bile-spewer.title: Bile Spewer
bile-spewer.description: The Bile Spewer is an armored Terminid developed from the Nursing Spewer and filled with enormous quantities of corrosive acid. It attacks Helldivers by projecting streams of bile capable of burning and slowing its targets. More developed Bile Spewers can also bombard distant positions with bile projectiles, giving the Terminid swarm a form of organic artillery support.

nursing-spewer.title: Nursing Spewer
nursing-spewer.description: The Nursing Spewer is a medium-sized Terminid capable of projecting corrosive digestive fluids over a wide area. Fluids once associated with feeding smaller Terminid strains have become dangerous biological weapons against Helldivers. Nursing Spewers also generate a thin cloud of spores around themselves that can obscure nearby smaller Terminids, providing the swarm with both ranged firepower and concealment.

bile-warrior.title: Bile Warrior
bile-warrior.description: The Bile Warrior is a mutated variant of the standard Terminid Warrior whose body is filled with corrosive bile. Its behavior closely resembles an ordinary Warrior, including its ability to summon Bug Breaches through pheromone signals. When killed through damage to its body, however, the creature can violently explode and spray damaging bile across nearby Helldivers and Terminids.

bile-spitter.title: Bile Spitter
bile-spitter.description: The Bile Spitter is one of the smallest Terminid organisms but possesses a dangerous ranged attack. Exposure to toxic chemicals caused the creature to develop the ability to launch globules of corrosive bile at its enemies. Its acid can damage and slow Helldivers, while killing a Bile Spitter can cause its body to rupture in a small bile explosion capable of harming nearby targets.
